defs.def: either of the two organs in the chest that you use for breathing 肺

ex.s: Its lung capacity is smaller than we think.
ex.t: 它的肺活量比我们想象的要小。

ex.s: Rainforests are the lungs of the planet-storing vast quantities of carbon dioxide and producing a significant amount of the world's oxygen.
ex.t: 令人惊奇的是，这些树的生长方式使得它们的叶子和枝条虽然紧密相邻，却从不真正接触另一棵树的叶子和枝条。

ex.s: Her monitor has shown that air pollution levels are higher closer to ground level, which has helped highlight concerns that babies and young kids may be at higher risk of developing lung problems.
ex.t: 她的监测器显示，越靠近地面，空气污染水平越高，这凸显了人们对婴儿和幼儿可能面临更高患肺病风险的担忧。

ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 新鲜空气清洁我们的肺部。

ex.s: Unexpectedly, I’m face-to-face with the gorilla, who begins screaming at    62    top of her lungs.
ex.t: 出乎意料地，我与那只大猩猩面对面，它开始___62____声嘶力竭地尖叫。

ex.s: I only joined my local athletics club because my doctor told me that in my particular case exercise could improve how my lungs work.
ex.t: 我之所以加入本地田径俱乐部，完全是因为我的医生告诉我，就我而言，运动可以改善我的肺功能。

ex.s: I was also caught up in the excitement and cheered so hard that I thought my lungs would burst!
ex.t: 我也被这激动人心的氛围所感染，拼命欢呼，以为我的肺会爆炸！

ex.s: With trees in the shallows, the wetland is a natural system for providing clean water and producing oxygen, which makes it the “green lungs of Hangzhou”.
ex.t: 湿地中有浅水树木，是一个天然的提供清洁水和产生氧气的系统，使它成为杭州的绿肺。

ex.s: Researchers are working on making a form of medicine that can be taken directly into one’s lungs, to the chance of side effects.
ex.t: 研究人员正在研究一种可以直接被吸入肺部的药物形式，以降低副作用的风险。

ex.s: He said the nicotine in tobacco is and can do great damage to my father’s lungs.
ex.t: 他说烟草中的尼古丁是，会对我父亲的肺造成很大的伤害。
